How do I use it properly the very first time?
11:13
Using your jewellery for the first time is so exciting! Here’s how to make the most of it:
Unbox with Care: Your piece will arrive in our beautiful packaging, so take a moment to enjoy the unboxing experience—it’s part of the fun!
Wear Last: When getting ready, put your jewellery on last to avoid contact with perfumes, lotions, or makeup, which can affect its shine.
Handle Gently: If it’s a pendant or charm, attach it carefully to your chain. For bracelets or necklaces, ensure the clasp is secure.
Care Tips: Avoid water, harsh chemicals, and store it in a clean, dry place when not in use to keep it looking stunning.
Enjoy your new piece—it’s going to look amazing on you! Let me know if you have any other questions. 🧡
